title: How Taskly stores a task
goal: Understand how a task goes from the web page into the database, and how a user stays signed in.

includes: The path from the web page to the database
excludes: Email reminders, which are planned and not built

components.label: Web page
components.summary: Lists tasks and sends new ones to the API.

components.label: API
components.summary: Three routes: list tasks, add a task, toggle a task.

components.label: Session check
components.summary: Reads the session cookie and rejects the request when it is not valid.

components.label: Task store
components.summary: Runs the three task queries for one user.

components.label: Database
components.summary: A SQLite file with a users table and a tasks table.

components.label: Email reminders
components.summary: Planned. Would email a user about tasks that are due.

items.text: The fixture does not show how long a session cookie lasts.

steps.caption: The page posts the new title.
The API checks the cookie, then hands the title to the task store.
The task store inserts a row in the tasks table.
